name: Chocolate Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Chocolate Shop is an exciting time-management game that you have to play. This restaurant game has 10 levels for you to complete. Your goal is to keep all of your customers happy, make chocolate, and keep the business running. This is a tycoon game that's fun to play and will keep you interested with its fast-paced duties. On the top tab, you'll find your goals, score, a timer, and your level to help you keep track of your success. Don't forget to submit your score!
